text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 139 March 2, 1973
EXCLUDING FROM THE PROPERTIES TRANSFERRED TO THE LAND BANK UNDER REPUBLIC
ACT NO. 6390 CERTAIN PARCELS THEREOF OCCUPIED BY THE CITY ENGINEER'S OFFICE OF
By virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of all the Armed Forces of
the Philippines and pursuant to Proclamation No. 1081 dated September 21, 1972, and General Order No. 1
dated September 22, 1972, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, do hereby exclude
from the provisions of Section 9 of Republic Act No. 6390, transferring certain government properties of the
private domain to the Land Bank, and reserve the same for the use of the City of Manila, which parcels of land
are commonly known as follows:
1. Lot No. 6, Block No. 939
2. Lot No. 5, Block No. 936
containing a total area of thirty-one thousand, two hundred eighty-four square meters (31,284), more or less,
situated in Nagtahan, Sta. Mesa, Manila.
This Decree is hereby made a part of the law of the land and shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-three.
